fields.label: Case name
fields.help: Primary case identifier used by outputs.

fields.label: Date & time
fields.help: 14-digit timestamp used by LUW workflows.

fields.label: Longitude range
fields.help: Manual clipping range in longitude.

fields.label: Latitude range
fields.help: Manual clipping range in latitude.

fields.label: UTM X range
fields.help: Manual clipping range in projected UTM X.

fields.label: UTM Y range
fields.help: Manual clipping range in projected UTM Y.

fields.label: X range
fields.help: Projected X range of CFD domain in meters.

fields.label: Y range
fields.help: Projected Y range of CFD domain in meters.

fields.label: Z range
fields.help: Projected Z range of CFD domain in meters.

fields.label: Base height
fields.help: Ground/base slab thickness in meters.

fields.label: Height limit
fields.help: Low-altitude vertical target range in meters.

fields.label: Geometry representation
fields.help: Select whether buildings, terrain, or both are included.

fields.label: Height key
fields.help: Building shapefile field used as the extrusion height. Use "Inferred" to detect a standard height field automatically.

fields.label: Ignore under
fields.help: Ignore building features whose resolved height is less than or equal to this threshold in meters.

fields.label: Terrain approach
fields.help: Terrain interpolation algorithm used during voxelization. The native compute backend is selected independently by preprocess_use_gpu and preprocess_gpu_device.

fields.label: Grid resolution (m)
fields.help: Terrain interpolation grid spacing in meters for terrain voxelization.

fields.label: IDW sigma
fields.help: Gaussian smoothing strength applied after terrain interpolation. Building-base lookup uses a lighter half-strength smoothing pass.

fields.label: IDW power
fields.help: Inverse-distance weighting power used by terrain voxelization when the approach is IDW.

fields.label: Neighboring points (N)
fields.help: Number of nearby DEM samples used by terrain voxel interpolation.

fields.label: Mid-mesh base size
fields.help: Base mesh size for preprocessing boundary construction.

fields.label: UTM CRS
fields.help: Projected coordinate reference system.

fields.label: UTM EPSG
fields.help: Projected EPSG code.

fields.label: UTM string
fields.help: Legacy projected CRS string.

fields.label: UTM zone
fields.help: UTM zone number.

fields.label: UTM hemisphere
fields.help: UTM hemisphere indicator.

fields.label: Rotate angle
fields.help: Rotation applied to align the CFD box.

fields.label: Center longitude
fields.help: Reference longitude of the domain center.

fields.label: Center latitude
fields.help: Reference latitude of the domain center.

fields.label: Use GPU
fields.help: Use the selected OpenCL GPU for GPU-capable native preprocessing kernels. Explicit GPU selection fails instead of silently falling back to CPU.

fields.label: GPU device
fields.help: Zero-based OpenCL GPU device index used when preprocess_use_gpu is true.

fields.label: Origin shift applied
fields.help: Whether origin shift has been applied.

fields.label: Volume mean velocity
fields.help: Volume-mean uvw written by preprocessing.

fields.label: Boundary mean velocity
fields.help: Boundary mean uvw written by preprocessing.

fields.label: Downstream face
fields.help: Computed downstream boundary face.

fields.label: Downstream yaw
fields.help: Computed downstream yaw angle.

fields.label: CFD solver
fields.help: Select CULBM (the default) or explicitly opt in to FluidX3D. SurfaceIBM requires CULBM.

fields.label: GPU split
fields.help: Triplet of GPU partition counts.

fields.label: Mesh control
fields.help: Choose between GPU memory target and explicit cell size.

fields.label: GPU memory (MiB)
fields.help: Target GPU memory for automatic resolution sizing.

fields.label: Cell size (m)
fields.help: Explicit cell size in meters when mesh_control=cell_size.

fields.label: CUDA nesting height above compact ground top (m)
fields.help: Optional CUDA-only fixed horizontal interface heights in SI meters above the top of the compacted ground layer (not terrain-relative AGL): [] disables nesting; [h] uses half the base cell size below h; [h_low, h_high] uses quarter size below h_low, half size from h_low to h_high, and the base size above h_high. Interfaces use conservative 4-to-1 averaging.

fields.label: Validation status
fields.help: Validation flag written by prerun validation.

fields.label: High order interpolation
fields.help: Enable higher-order interpolation.

fields.label: Flux correction
fields.help: Enable post-voxel flux correction.

fields.label: Downstream open
fields.help: Use special downstream outlet handling instead of a fixed velocity face.

fields.label: Run steps override
fields.help: Force solver run length in steps.

fields.label: Research output stride
fields.help: Snapshot output cadence for research runs.

fields.label: Unsteady output stride
fields.help: Write unsteady VTK every N steps.

fields.label: CULBM unsteady output start step
fields.help: CULBM only: first eligible step for periodic unsteady velocity output (default 0). The stride remains aligned to step zero; final outputs are unchanged.

fields.label: CULBM global VTK
fields.help: CULBM only: write one final structured VTK in STL metric coordinates. z=0 is the non-basement STL datum.

fields.label: CULBM global NetCDF
fields.help: CULBM only: write one final structured NetCDF-3 file in STL metric coordinates. z=0 is the non-basement STL datum.

fields.label: CULBM global VTKHDF
fields.help: CULBM only: write one final HDF5-backed VTKHDF ImageData file in STL metric coordinates. z=0 is the non-basement STL datum; HDF5 support is required at build time.

fields.label: CULBM AGL point VTK
fields.help: CULBM only: read proj_temp/interpolated_dem.csv, remove points at/below terrain, and write final AGL point-data VTK.

fields.label: CULBM AGL point NetCDF
fields.help: CULBM only: read proj_temp/interpolated_dem.csv, remove points at/below terrain, and write final AGL point NetCDF-3 data.

fields.label: Probe output stride
fields.help: Sampling interval for probe outputs.

fields.label: Average purge stride
fields.help: Average purge cadence.

fields.label: Average purge sub-stride
fields.help: Subsampling stride for purge-avg.

fields.label: Averaged scalar outputs
fields.help: Comma-separated subset from tke, ti, tls.

fields.label: Probe definitions
fields.help: Raw probe definition tokens.

fields.label: Coriolis term
fields.help: Enable the Coriolis source term.

fields.label: Buoyancy
fields.help: Request buoyancy-driven temperature coupling. If no valid temperature boundary is supplied, the solver automatically disables buoyancy feedback.

fields.label: CULBM momentum velocity set
fields.help: Momentum lattice of CULBM. D3Q19 (default) is the production lattice; D3Q27 adds the eight corner directions for higher isotropy at about 40% more DDF memory and bandwidth.

fields.label: CULBM DDF storage format
fields.help: Storage format of the CULBM distribution functions; arithmetic is always FP32. FP16C (default) is the accurate custom 16-bit format, FP16S the range-shifted IEEE half format with hardware conversion, FP32 doubles DDF memory and bandwidth.

fields.label: CULBM temperature lattice
fields.help: Select the GPU temperature distribution lattice. D3Q19 uses more memory/bandwidth and provides the higher-isotropy scalar stencil.

fields.label: Base kinematic viscosity (m2/s)
fields.help: Positive finite molecular/base kinematic viscosity in SI m2/s, before any SGS eddy viscosity is added.

fields.label: Base thermal diffusivity (m2/s)
fields.help: Positive finite molecular/base thermal diffusivity in SI m2/s, before turbulent scalar diffusivity is added.

fields.label: SGS LES
fields.help: Enable the GPU Smagorinsky-Lilly subgrid-scale model.

fields.label: Smagorinsky Cs
fields.help: Non-negative traditional Smagorinsky constant Cs. Do not set together with culbm_sgs_cs_squared.

fields.label: Smagorinsky Cs squared
fields.help: Optional non-negative Cs squared input; the solver takes its square root. Mutually exclusive with culbm_sgs_cs.

fields.label: SGS scalar coupling
fields.help: Add turbulent thermal diffusivity alpha_t=nu_t/Pr_t to the GPU temperature collision.

fields.label: Turbulent Prandtl
fields.help: Positive finite turbulent Prandtl number Pr_t used by SGS scalar coupling.

fields.label: SGS diagnostics stride
fields.help: Write GPU-derived spatial mean/maximum eddy-viscosity diagnostics every N LBM steps; 0 disables diagnostics.

fields.label: Wall model
fields.help: CULBM log-law wall-stress model on link-wise bounce-back walls (default true). It replaces the under-resolved no-slip shear of wall-adjacent cells by the equilibrium wall stress; false restores plain no-slip bounce-back. With SurfaceIBM see culbm_wall_model_ibm.

fields.label: Wall model on IBM surfaces
fields.help: With ibm_enabler and culbm_wall_model: also wall-model the SurfaceIBM surfaces (default true). Bodies keep their voxel solid core with free-slip faces and the log-law stress is applied one-sided on the exterior cells from the surface normal, area and wall distance; false keeps the no-slip immersed-boundary forcing and wall-models only the voxel walls (ground slab, terrain).

fields.label: Wall model z0 ground (m)
fields.help: Aerodynamic roughness length in SI metres for upward-facing horizontal solid faces (ground, roofs); default 0.03. 0 selects the smooth-wall log law.

fields.label: Wall model z0 building (m)
fields.help: Aerodynamic roughness length in SI metres for vertical and downward-facing solid faces; default 0.01. 0 selects the smooth-wall log law.

fields.label: Wall model SGS layers
fields.help: Number of lattice rows above upward-facing walls (ground, roofs) in which the Smagorinsky length is raised to kappa*z_w to remove the log-layer mismatch of the wall-modelled first rows; default 3, 0 disables. Requires culbm_sgs_enable=true.

fields.label: Wall model von Karman constant
fields.help: von Karman constant of the wall-model log law, in (0, 1]; default 0.41.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM
fields.help: Enable the optional direct-forcing momentum SurfaceIBM for interior curved/oblique walls. False preserves the voxel-wall path; global-shell and solid-temperature walls are not converted.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM delta kernel
fields.help: Regularized delta stencil used for Eulerian/Lagrangian interpolation and force spreading.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM geometry policy
fields.help: exterior_union requires watertight manifold components and uses marker-patch sampling to filter duplicate/internal surfaces; all_triangles retains every unique valid triangle only for intentional open-sheet or diagnostic cases.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM marker spacing (lu)
fields.help: Positive target Lagrangian marker spacing in lattice units.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM forcing iterations
fields.help: Maximum coupling-normalized multi-direct-forcing corrections per LBM step; supported range is 1 to 32 and convergence may stop earlier.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM relaxation
fields.help: Finite relaxation applied to each direct-forcing correction; must be greater than 0 and strictly less than 2.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM residual tolerance
fields.help: Absolute marker-slip tolerance in lattice velocity units used for early convergence; an exhausted iteration limit is reported explicitly.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM marker retraction (lu)
fields.help: Non-negative solid-side normal retraction in lattice units. The validated Roma3 surface-wall profile uses 0.5 lu to register the hydrodynamic wall with the input surface.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM effective thickness (lu)
fields.help: Positive effective surface-quadrature thickness used in marker volume/force weighting. If omitted, it follows marker spacing.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM maximum markers
fields.help: Positive marker hard cap; attach also checks exact fragment buffers against live per-device free memory.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM strict geometry
fields.help: Reject non-finite, degenerate, same-winding duplicate, open/non-manifold, or ambiguous geometry; opposite coincident faces in an exterior union cancel.

fields.label: SurfaceIBM diagnostics stride
fields.help: Report marker-slip and reaction-force diagnostics every N LBM steps; 0 disables periodic diagnostics.

fields.label: Buffer nudging
fields.help: Enable outer-domain buffer nudging.

fields.label: Buffer thickness
fields.help: Nudging thickness in meters.

fields.label: Buffer tau
fields.help: Nudging timescale in seconds.

fields.label: Vertical nudging
fields.help: Include vertical velocity in buffer nudging.

fields.label: Top sponge layer
fields.help: Enable top sponge layer damping.

fields.label: Sponge thickness
fields.help: Top sponge thickness in meters.

fields.label: Sponge tau
fields.help: Top sponge timescale in seconds.

fields.label: Sponge reference mode
fields.help: 0/mode0 or 1/geostrophic.

fields.label: Turbulence inflow
fields.help: Enable synthetic turbulence inflow.

fields.label: Synthetic approach
fields.help: Select the synthetic turbulence approach.

fields.label: Turbulence intensity
fields.help: Turbulence intensity fraction.

fields.label: Fluctuation sigma
fields.help: Velocity fluctuation sigma in m/s.

fields.label: Length scale
fields.help: Integral length scale in meters.

fields.label: Mode count
fields.help: Mode count.

fields.label: Random seed
fields.help: Random seed.

fields.label: Update stride
fields.help: Update interval in solver steps.

fields.label: Characteristic speed mode
fields.help: Characteristic speed for turbulence intensity scaling.

fields.label: Same realization on all faces
fields.help: Use the same random realization on every inflow face.

fields.label: Stride interpolation
fields.help: Enable stride interpolation.

fields.label: Inflow only
fields.help: When true, apply VK on the three lateral side faces except the outlet face; when false, apply VK on all four lateral side faces. The top face is excluded by the default side-face policy.

fields.label: Anisotropy
fields.help: Anisotropy scale triplet [x,y,z].

fields.label: X expansion ratio
fields.help: Batch STL base expansion ratio along X.

fields.label: Y expansion ratio
fields.help: Batch STL base expansion ratio along Y.

fields.label: Inflow list
fields.help: Dataset-generation inflow magnitudes in m/s.

fields.label: Angle list
fields.help: Batch inflow direction angles in degrees.
